info.title: Stellar Pay API
info.description: REST API for Stellar Pay (testnet). Amounts are decimal strings of token base units. Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`.

secretKey.description: Secret API key (`sk_test_...`). Server-to-server only; never use it in a browser.

amount.description: Amount in token base units, as a decimal string

fee.description: Fee in base units (set once settled)

amount.description: Amount in token base units, as a decimal string

token.description: Token contract id; must equal the configured token if given

reference.description: Merchant reference (off-chain; only a salted hash goes on-chain)

metadata.description: Merchant key/value data (off-chain only, max 20 keys)

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page

amount.description: Amount in token base units, as a decimal string

transactionXdr.description: Unsigned, simulated and assembled transaction (base64 XDR)

secret.description: Signing secret. Returned only once, at creation.

key.description: The secret key. Returned only once.

post.description: Creates the payment on-chain (`create_payment`, operator-signed). Returns 201 once confirmed, or 202 with status `pending` if the chain outcome is not known yet.

schema.description: Required. Retries with the same key and body return the original response.

403.description: API key lacks the required scope

409.description: Contract rejected the call or idempotency key in progress

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body

schema.description: Return payments updated at or after this time, oldest update first (aggregator feed)

post.description: The envelope must be exactly one invocation of this contract's `pay(payer, id)` with the payer as source and signer. Anything else is rejected with `INVALID_TRANSACTION`.
